locations.note: The idol Alice Hiiragi's Jail turns Shibuya into a Wonderland; thrown into a dumpster beneath it, Joker, Ryuji and Morgana meet the AI Sophia.
On the road with Inspector Zenkichi Hasegawa, the Thieves meet the AI expert Kuon Ichinose over beef tongue and change the heart of Ango Natsume, Monarch of the Sendai Jail.
In Sapporo the Thieves enter the Jail of Mariko Hyodo and change her heart.
An abandoned Jail in Okinawa shows the Thieves where EMMA's power to make Jails came from, and they come home branded as terrorists.
Zenkichi's estranged daughter Akane rules the Kyoto Jail; the Thieves are caught inside until Futaba brings Zenkichi in to reach her.
In Osaka the Thieves change the heart of Akira Konoe, the head of Madicce, and shut the EMMA app down.
When EMMA restarts and blacks out Tokyo, a giant Jail rises in Yokohama, where the Thieves find Ichinose waiting and learn how people's dependence on EMMA made the AI self-aware.
EMMA grows a last Jail, the Tree of Knowledge, at Tokyo Tower, where the Thieves fight the AI that calls itself the Demiurge.

routes.name: The Phantom Thieves' summer road trip
routes.note: A summer camping trip that turns into a Jail hunt from Shibuya to Sendai, Sapporo, Okinawa, Kyoto and Osaka, then Yokohama and back to Tokyo Tower.
